$comment: DRAFT — not a shipped contract. Authority: docs/01-CONTRACT.md §3. Intentionally byte-identical in shape to ethos.grounding.v1's coordinate_system object, so the M5 projection is a move rather than a translation.
title: Coordinate system declaration (DRAFT)
description: Declared on every artifact carrying geometry, never omitted and never implied by the format. PDF's native origin is bottom-left; the artifact's is top-left, and this declaration is how a reader knows the transform happened. An artifact that cannot be interpreted without its source file is not evidence.

unit.description: 1/100 of a PostScript point. A single-valued enum today; a const today is a discriminator tomorrow, which is why it is written rather than assumed.

origin.description: Origin at the top-left corner; x grows right, y grows down.
